// Issue #140: Immortal Servitude at X = 4 returns every Cid Buried Alive put
// into the graveyard.
//
// Twenty-one cards on the play. Five nonlands cannot keep a land out of any
// turn's hand, so the drop is made every turn: Buried Alive is cast on turn 3

// on turn 7.

1x Buried Alive [Tutor]
1x Immortal Servitude [Reanimation]
3x Cid, Timeless Artificer [Cid]
